QuestInfo.name: Reason for Wanting to become an Adult
QuestInfo.0: Korin is still a child even after you brought the #t4033863#. You guess #t4033863# wasn't affective in making Korin an adult...\r\n
QuestInfo.1: You wonder why Korin wants to become an adult. Go ask people of Ludibrium about Korin.
QuestInfo.2: Korin wants to become come an adult because she wants to earn money to help her parents. It's a sad situation but will Korin becoming an adult solve anything?

speech.0: Yeah, Korin hasn't hugged me very much lately. Maybe it's cause I got skinnier? I need to stuff more cotton into my belly!
Korin is a very nice child. She still laughs at my hasty magic. But for some reason she stopped laughing lately. Maybe something's bothering her?
I've been feeling a little hopeless since Korin hasn't come to see me. She would sometimes come to wind my spring, but now nobody's doing it. Could you wind my spring since you're here?
Oh, Korin? I haven't seen her lately. She was huge a fan of toys, so she'd often come to the factory. Maybe she's feeling ill? Maybe her friend #rNemi#k knows something.
Why is Korin feeling so down lately? Probably because of her family. They're all really busy working at the toy factory, so Korin is often home alone.

1.0: Why do I want to become an adult? I want to start working. If I bring home money, then our family can actually eat dinner together.

default.0: How can I become an adult?
